Worries over data center curbs accelerate skid in Asian markets

Taiwan's Taiex fell around 9% in morning trading on Nov. 6. © Reuters

TOKYO -- Asian stock markets tied to the artificial intelligence boom plummeted on Friday morning following a tech sell-off on Wall Street overnight, as investors fretted about possible delays in the construction of data centers following a sweeping Democratic victory in the U.S. midterm elections.
